en: Do you have a Cottonee? I'd swap my Petilil for one.
text: Ai un Cottonee? Mi-aș schimba Petilil-ul pe unul.

en: A Cottonee! Thank you. Petulia is shy, so be gentle with her.
text: Un Cottonee! Mulțumesc. Petulia e timidă, așa că fii blând cu ea.

en: That isn't a Cottonee. It's a Cottonee I want.
text: Ăsta nu e un Cottonee. Eu vreau un Cottonee.

en: Oh. If you catch a Cottonee, will you come back?
text: Oh. Dacă prinzi un Cottonee, vei reveni?

en: Cottonee floats around my room like a cloud. I hope Petulia is happy with you.
text: Cottonee plutește prin camera mea ca un nor. Sper că Petulia e fericită cu tine.
